Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null"
Else
P=CStr(v)
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim f As Object,s As String
Worksheets("Data").Activate
s="owner=["
For Each f In Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & TypeName(f) & ":" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ":p=" & CStr(f.Priority) & ":color=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & "|"
Next
s=s & "];slots=["
For Each f In Worksheets("Witness").Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & f.AppliesTo.Address & ":" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & "|"
Next
Snapshot=s & "]"
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim w As Worksheet,f As Object,target As Object,s As String,i As Long
Set w=Worksheets.Add(After:=Worksheets(Worksheets.Count))
w.Name="Witness"
For i=1 To 6
Set f=w.Range(w.Cells(1,i*2-1),w.Cells(2,i*2-1)).FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbMagenta
Next
s="before=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Worksheets("Data").Activate
For Each f In Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions
If f.Priority=2 Then Set target=f
Next
target.ModifyAppliesToRange Worksheets("Data").Range("A1:A3")
s=s & ";after=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Set f=Worksheets("Data").Range("J1:J2").FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=RGB(0,255,255)
Probe=s & ";afterCyan=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null"
Else
P=CStr(v)
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim f As Object,s As String
Worksheets("Data").Activate
s="owner=["
For Each f In Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & TypeName(f) & ":" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ":p=" & CStr(f.Priority) & ":color=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & "|"
Next
s=s & "];slots=["
For Each f In Worksheets("Witness").Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & f.AppliesTo.Address & ":" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & "|"
Next
Snapshot=s & "]"
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim w As Worksheet,f As Object,target As Object,s As String,i As Long
Set w=Worksheets.Add(After:=Worksheets(Worksheets.Count))
w.Name="Witness"
For i=1 To 6
Set f=w.Range(w.Cells(1,i*2-1),w.Cells(2,i*2-1)).FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbMagenta
Next
s="before=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Worksheets("Data").Activate
For Each f In Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions
If f.Type=5 Then Set target=f
Next

f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=RGB(0,255,255)
Probe=s & ";afterCyan=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

Dim f As Object,g As Object,h As Object
ActiveSheet.Name="Data"
